note: min+gz budgets in bytes, enforced by scripts/size-check.mjs (esbuild bundle via the published exports map, minify, gzip -9). The full budget is the measured baseline + 2%. `baseline` blocks record the last measured numbers behind a budget — they are evidence, not gates. Entries with pending:true are declared slots a later phase graduates; the gate skips them with the notice in `pendingReason` and they gate nothing until the flag is dropped. Informational entries (no gzipBudgetBytes) are measured and printed, never gated. `external` keeps framework peer deps out of a fixture's bundle so the framework fixtures measure the comvi graph only. `sentinelModules` + `expectSentinels` assert module-graph membership from the esbuild metafile (module IDs, never output text); `node scripts/size-check.mjs --modules` prints the full comvi module list behind those fixtures.
